testSet: Same four saved real-camera VGA luminance frames as earlier raw stress test; each attempted six times per decoder. Not24distinct frames.

successBenchmark.input: Same four private real-camera VGA luminance frames used in raw stress test
successBenchmark.protocol: Two reversed-order rounds, three attempts/frame/decoder = 24 attempts each
stages: Full-frame ZXing HybridBinarizer local threshold, without QR decoding
successBenchmark.timing: Includes preprocessing, native process startup, loading and temporary I/O. Source frames loaded before timer. Child CPU included.
successBenchmark.stopRule: Stop at any decoded symbol; known target is used only for result checking

rawStressBenchmark.input: Identical Pillow L luminance bytes; no JPEG or preprocessing in timed calls
rawStressBenchmark.scope: Static public target, saved real camera frames; not live/animated app integration
rawStressBenchmark.timing: Per-call wall time; QR-only, default search settings, ZXing LocalAverage
rawStressBenchmark.memory: Current-executable /proc/self/status VmHWM, including Python for ZBar and static C++ for ZXing; not isolated library overhead

finding: All four fixed cascades pass24/24 on the same original frames. Common fallback sequence is fullraw, fixedcenterROI, fullframeHybridBinarizer. No perframe settings or target-dependent fallback decisions.
preprocessingDependency: The final fallback uses ZXing3.1.1 HybridBinarizer without invoking QR decoding. Thus quirc/ZBar successful pipelines include that shared preprocessing implementation; these are not unassisted library results.
limits: Four frames from a single static printed public target; six repetitions measure timing, not scene diversity.
Timings include preprocessing, temporary files, native process startup and loading. Source frame loading and initial Python imports precede timing.
Prototype pipeline wall times are not final SeedSigner app performance or live FPS.
Earlier standalone reader RSS excludes the parent and threshold worker; it is not total memory of these cascades.
Fresh framing/light, binary app integration and animated assembly remain open.
